digest.component_or_area: event store write seam and secret detection
propositions: Event bodies containing secrets are accepted at the write seam with no content screening, allowing credentials posted in comments or Jira-sourced events to enter the append-only store
Store writes from multiple callers bypass append_event and call finalize_event halves directly, leaving a screen at append_event unable to protect against external sources like Jira reconciliation

A single secret-bearing event triggered GitHub push protection rejection of the shared tickets branch, queuing all concurrent sessions' writes local-only and causing a full store-sharing outage presenting as transient contention
Refusal of writes matching credential patterns must be loud and reversible with an audited override to avoid permanent hard-blocking legitimate security-related documentation and incident reporting
Secret refusal messages must not echo credential values or their fragments across exception messages, stdout, stderr, logs, or disk to prevent secondary leaks through the remediation mechanism itself
